home.headline: I'm a product designer who brings strategy, visual design, and code together
home.introduction: Work & Co’s hands-on approach to product design connects with how I work: exploring ideas, refining interactions, and staying involved through implementation. I bring a visual designer’s eye and a developer’s understanding of how the experience works, with accessibility built into the decisions along the way.
home.projectsIntroduction: These case studies show how I connect product strategy with visual design, develop interactive tools, and work with clients and developers to bring the details into production.
home.who: I'm a New York–based product designer and inclusive design advocate. My work brings together UX research, visual design, illustration, and front-end development. I’ve managed and mentored designers as a UX Director, and I stay closely involved in the design and implementation.
home.what: I work with clients and developers to turn complex requirements into interfaces people can understand and use. Wireframes and prototypes help me explore the interactions; visual design gives them clarity and character. I carry that work into reusable components and production code, refining the experience as the product evolves.
home.articlesIntroduction: A closer look at the interaction details, visual communication, and accessibility decisions behind my work.
